SSV Network is a decentralized network for distributed validator technology on Ethereum. SSV Network splits validator keys across multiple operators so that a validator can keep running if some operators fail. SSV Network uses the SSV token to pay for its services.

IPFS is a peer-to-peer distributed file system. IPFS addresses content by its cryptographic hash rather than by its location. IPFS is not a financial service and does not itself run on a public blockchain.

ENS is the Ethereum Name Service, a decentralized naming system built on Ethereum. ENS maps human-readable names to Ethereum addresses and other resources. ENS domain names are represented as non-fungible tokens.

Flexa is a payments network that lets consumers pay merchants with cryptocurrency at the point of sale. Flexa connects merchants and payment providers through its network.

Lightning Network is a second-layer payment protocol built on the Bitcoin blockchain. Lightning Network uses payment channels to move transactions off-chain. Lightning Network aims to make Bitcoin payments fast and low-cost.
